On Jun 19, 2013 1:53 PM, "Sebastian Raschka" <rasc...@msu.edu> wrote:
Dear Adrian Dragulescu,

I noticed something odd today. I have a few scripts that I was using
with my older version of R (2.15). I updated R a few weeks ago and I am
running version 3.0.1.

I noticed that the xlsx package does not work as it did before:

E.g., I have an xlsx file that contains 20,000 lines, however, I only
want to read the first 100 lines.

Previously

myTable <- read.xlsx("myData.xlsx",
    sheetIndex = 1,
    rowIndex = 1:100,
    colIndex = 1:3)

worked for me. However, now it is reading all 20,000 lines. Is it a bug
or has something changed with the new release of R and this package?


Best regards,
Sebastian Raschka

Please use the mailing list to report future problems.

Best regards,
Adrian
